message_text: My I-20 hasn't arrived and my visa interview is next week. I'm panicking.
I understand your concern. Let me check the status. Have you submitted all required financial documents?
Yes everything was submitted a month ago. This delay is unacceptable.
I see your documents were received. The I-20 processing has been delayed. I can request an expedited electronic I-20 sent via email.
Why wasn't this done automatically? Other universities sent me their I-20 in a week.
I sincerely apologize for the delay. I'm requesting the expedited I-20 now. You should receive it within 24-48 hours.
